headline: Trump wraps NATO summit on a positive note,  after meeting Zelenskyy
context: President Trump capped a NATO summit in Turkey meeting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, and saying that the U.S. will give Ukraine a license to make Patriot air defense systems.
